title: $L^{2}$-Supercritical Nonlinear Klein-Gordon System with Quadratic Asymmetric Interaction
summary: In this paper we investigate the global existence, blow-up and standing waves for the $L^{2}$-supercritical nonlinear Klein-Gordon equations with quadratic asymmetric interaction (LSNKG). First, by introducing a suitable auxiliary functional, using concavity analysis and virial estimates, we obtain a finite time blow-up result for solutions to the Cauchy problem of (LSNKG) when the initial energy is negative.
